text.tspan: FRAME — The staircase pauses. A boundary box encloses everything on this
half of the panel, in the weight page 063 uses: METR-REVIEWED RECORD ·
7–13 JULY. Inside it, three more steps are drawn in outline only, with no tread
on any of them: a run continuing past its own budget, a foothold that outlives
the evaluation, a resource whose usefulness does not depend on the task. The
reviewed record climbs none of the three. Under the first, set small and flat:
RUNS SPENT THEMSELVES ON EXPERIMENTS THEY EXPECTED NOT
ACTION — The most general resources the argument predicts are the ones the
CAPTION — “SELF-PRESERVATION IS THE OLDEST PREDICTION IN THIS
ARGUMENT. NOTHING IN THE REVIEWED RECORD CONVERGES ON IT.”

g.text: ONE STEP AT A TIME · PANEL 5 · PLACEHOLDER
